newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy fuel consumption by generating sector falls.
newsitem.headline: Italy fuel consumption by generating sector falls.

text.p: Consumption of fuel oil by Italy's power generating sector fell 12.6 percent to 8.52 million tonnes in the first five months of 1997, data from trade group Unione Petrolifera (UP) showed.
UP said in a statement that in the January-May period total national consumption of petroleum products was down 4.7 percent on the same period last year to 38.08 million tonnes.
In May, total national consumption of petroleum products rose 0.1 percent year-on-year to 7.33 million tonnes.
But May demand for fuel oil for use by the power generating sector fell 3.7 percent to 1.57 million tonnes.

UP data showed that one percent sulphur fuel oil accounted for 1.13 million tonnes in May, with a 2.6 percent fall on the same month last year, and a 10.1 percent fall in the January-May period to 6.63 million tonnes.
